content: The test image shows a green mango leaf with discrete dark brown/black necrotic spots scattered across the blade — no white powder, no sooty coating, no tip dieback. This strongly suggests Anthracnose.

The reference Anthracnose image shows advanced yellowing/necrosis (different stage), but the test image's pattern — discrete, dark brown-black spots on an otherwise green leaf — is the classic early-stage Anthracnose presentation (Colletotrichum infection producing isolated necrotic lesions). This doesn't match Powdery_Mildew (white powder), Sooty_Mould (black coating), or Die_Back (tip/margin browning).
